name: motion
title: Motion: the entrance deck, section reveals and micro-interactions
shows: The hero's entrance deck (nine variants), the automatic section reveals (each section's h2 and lead photograph, once), buttons (1px up on hover, 2px on the large size, 1px down on press), arrows, links, the nav underline and menu, tabs, focus, cards, photographs, fields, switches, checks, rows that answer the pointer, a label that rolls, a number that rolls once, swatches that change the photograph, the open-now dot, numbers that tick once, and the loops inside a card's picture.

files.motion.css: link after system.css and ui/cards.css; rules apply under <html data-motion>
files.motion.js: type=module, after system.js; starts by itself; export { init, refresh }
files.demo.html: the tech side on one software page: tabs, counts, card stories, switches; ?theme=dark, ?live
files.deck.html: the deck on one bakery page: every entrance (?enter=<id>), the section reveals, rows, roll, swatches, open-now dot, rolling label, a drawing loop in a card; ?live, ?theme=dark

entrances.name: Line rise
entrances.sees: the h1 rises line by line out of word masks, then the lead, buttons and facts fade up 12px; the picture settles from 1.05

entrances.name: Set type
entrances.sees: the h1's lines rise while the picture opens downward like a blind

entrances.name: Focus pull
entrances.sees: the picture racks into focus from soft and a touch large; the h1 from half strength; nothing travels

entrances.name: Exposure
entrances.sees: the type stands; the photograph starts pale and its light and colour come up (use a mid or dark photograph)

entrances.name: Aperture
entrances.markup: data-enter="aperture" (style="--m-window: 30% 32%" centres the window on the subject)
entrances.sees: the type stands; the picture opens from a window in its middle out past its edges, from a detail to the whole
needs: picture at least half the hero

entrances.name: Line blocks
entrances.markup: data-enter="line-blocks" (--m-block on the hero sets the colour; the accent by default)
entrances.sees: each line of the h1 starts under a block of one palette colour as long as its words; the blocks slide off toward the line ends

entrances.name: Doors
entrances.markup: data-enter="doors" (--m-door: the cover's colour, --m-door-at: where it parts)
entrances.sees: a cover in one palette colour lies over the hero, parts along one line and slides off both ways; only the picture eases back
needs: hero at least 70% of the screen

entrances.name: Product at work
entrances.markup: data-enter="product-at-work" and data-enter-step on two to four parts inside the hero's window (a row that lands, a figure, a selected item)
entrances.sees: the h1 rises while the window's marked parts appear one after another: the product shows it is live
needs: window or UI fragment in the hero

entrances.name: Already there
entrances.sees: nothing arrives: the first frame is the finished hero; the motion is the hero's own clip, scene or loop
needs: moving picture or scene in the hero

reveals.what: each main section's first h2 (outside cards, rows and lists) rises out of its line masks in 620ms, and its lead photograph (the first img at least 280x160 outside cards, tiles and lists) settles from inset 7% 6% and scale 1.06 in 700ms, once, as each comes on screen
reveals.never: in the first screen, on a card, row, tile or list, in a section with data-moment, data-big-scene or data-scene, under reduced motion, without script, in a headless shot (unless data-motion="live")
reveals.marks: data-m-rv="heading" or "photo" on what reveals; .m-rv-wait while it waits

hooks.svg.m-arrow: <svg class="m-arrow" viewBox="0 0 12 12" aria-hidden="true"><path class="m-arrow__stem" d="M1 6h8"/><path class="m-arrow__head" d="M4.5 2.5 8 6l-3.5 3.5"/></svg> as the last child of a button, link, pill or a row's link
hooks.[data-m-count]: on a stat whose text holds one count (8,402 / 4.5 h / 64%); data-m-count="1600" sets the time in ms; once a page, in the hero
hooks.[data-m-roll]: on a price or a number: its digits roll up into place once when first seen (any kind)
hooks.[data-m-loop]: on a panel holding the page's own CSS keyframe loop; style --m-cycle (2.5s-4s) and --m-still (0-1, the finished frame); any kind with card visuals
hooks..m-draw: <path class="m-draw" pathLength="1" d="..."/> inside a [data-m-loop] svg: a route, a signature, steam, a path draws, holds and draws again
hooks..m-swap: on a .btn or nav link: its label rolls up and comes back from below on hover and focus (editorial, product, tech, playful)
hooks.[data-m-swatches]: ...
hooks.[data-open-now]: system.js writes the line; motion.js adds the dot that breathes twice while it says Open now
hooks..m-link: an underline that draws, on any other link
hooks..m-zoom: a wrapper whose img or video scales 1.03 on hover
hooks..m-nolift: a card that must not lift
hooks.data-still: on a section: no reveal in it
hooks.aria-current=\"page\": on the nav word of the page you are on

automatic: .frame__img and .tile__media img in a link or a card with a link
main section h2 and lead photograph (reveals)
reducedMotion: colours change; nothing moves or scales (a button keeps its colour change, a press shows as a deeper tone); the hero stands; no reveals; loops hold the --m-still frame; numbers show their final text; no pause buttons
phone: no hover states; the hero enters and sections reveal; the sheet fades in 8px; loops hold their finished frame like ui.js fragments
screenshot: a HeadlessChrome page shows the hero at rest, no reveals and final numbers unless <html data-motion="live">
cost: motion.css 42 KB, motion.js 37 KB unminified (about 7 KB and 10 KB gzipped); one IntersectionObserver per feature; transform, opacity and clip-path only in the layer (a hero variant also filter)
